_comment_auth: Domain/Username/Password are OPTIONAL. Omit all three (or leave them out entirely) to run as whatever Windows account this process/scheduled task runs as -- that account needs ApplicationImpersonation scoped to MailboxUpn, same as the SQLCLR EWS proc. Only set these if you need to run as a *different* account than the task's own identity.
_comment_sql: Use a SQL login with INSERT + SELECT on TableName. Windows auth (Integrated Security=true) also works if this process runs as an account with DB access.
_comment_log: Optional. If set, each run's log lines are appended here as well as printed to stdout (stdout isn't visible when Task Scheduler runs this unattended, so a log file is how you'll see what happened).
